title: Ribicoff mission on Soviet Jewish emigration and a Mossad/Shin Bet briefing
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Ribicoff mission on Soviet Jewish emigration and a Mossad/Shin Bet briefing, about 1970s at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In fact, I was sent to Jerusalem and got briefed by Bosad by Beth Shinb

plain: Harald Malmgren, who describes himself as a former adviser to US presidents, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a mission in the 1970s, linked to two Washington figures, Abe Ribicoff and Jake Javits, concerning Jewish people leaving the Soviet Union. As part of it, he says, he was sent to Jerusalem and briefed by Mossad, Israel's foreign intelligence service, and Shin Bet, its internal security service. He tells it as part of his account of how deep his access to secret government matters ran.
